levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or more of the four required artifacts is missing from the assembled packet.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All four artifacts are present in the packet.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The packet is organized in a way that would actually be usable, not just a loose pile of pieces.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: All three questions are matched to the same source category with no distinguishing reasoning.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Each question is matched to a plausible, distinct source category with a stated reason.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The reasoning correctly distinguishes categories by the actual nature of each question (safety versus pay versus scheduling).

lookFors: All four earlier artifacts are represented in the assembled packet.
The three source matches are not all identical.
No real employer lookup is required to complete the lesson at full credit.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
